tools.name: mofi_identity_get
tools.description: Return the name and email of the owner authorizing this Mofi connection.

tools.name: mofi_accounts_get
tools.description: Find one owned account, list owned accounts, or filter by connection. Monetary values use { amount, currency } with amount as an exact decimal string; credit limits are not cash. Continue collections with page.nextCursor unchanged.

tools.name: mofi_cards_get
tools.description: Find one masked card, list cards, or filter by account or connection. Monetary values use { amount, currency } with amount as an exact decimal string; credit limits and available credit are not bank cash. Pass page.nextCursor unchanged to continue the same query.

tools.name: mofi_spending_get

tools.name: mofi_connections_get
tools.description: Find one connected institution, list connections, or filter by status. Results are owner-scoped. Continue a collection with page.nextCursor unchanged.

tools.name: mofi_recurring_get
tools.description: Find repeated spending by payee (merchant or Pix recipient) and amount in an explicit period of at most 366 days. tools.name: mofi_classifications_get
tools.description: Lists the canonical categories and supported exact-match provider rules. Rule coverage is partial; unknown or conflicting labels are not guessed. Personal overrides from mofi_classifications_save are applied to transaction, spending, and recurring results; source labels remain unchanged.

tools.name: mofi_classifications_save
tools.description: Set or clear your normalized category for one transaction. This personal override is applied to transaction, spending, and recurring results; provider labels stay unchanged. It does not move money.

tools.name: mofi_sync_get
tools.description: Read synchronization jobs by ID, list jobs, or filter by connection and/or status. Results are owner-scoped. Continue collections with page.nextCursor unchanged.

tools.name: mofi_connections_sync
tools.description: Request a provider refresh and queue an import for one existing connection. A pending manual import may be coalesced and returned. Check mofi_sync_get before repeating an ambiguous request. This command never moves money.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "mofi_spending_summary_get" is 1392 chars, far longer than this server's median (263). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mofi_identity_get · Public sink: mofi_identity_get · Destructive: mofi_spending_get, mofi_spending_summary_get, mofi_recurring_get.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mofi_identity_get · Public sink: mofi_identity_get · Destructive: mofi_spending_get, mofi_spending_summary_get, mofi_recurring_get

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
